statement: scan surface must not silently drop a finding when the rule id is unknown.
why: An unknown rule id previously caused the finding to be dropped instead of reported as an error.
howToApply: Treat an unknown rule id as a hard error, never a silent skip.

howToApply: Treat an unknown rule id as a hard error in scan, check, run, and doctor alike.
